title: Steve Jobs: The Innovator Behind Apple

sentences.text: Steve Jobs was born on February 24, 1955.
He grew up in California.
As a child, he was very curious.
He loved to learn about electronics.
In high school, he met Steve Wozniak.
They became good friends.
They both loved computers.
In 1976, Jobs and Wozniak started Apple.
They worked in Jobs' garage.
They built the first Apple computer there.
It was called the Apple I.
It was a big success.
People loved it.
In 1984, Apple released the Macintosh.
It was the first computer with a mouse and a graphical user interface.
This was a big change.
It made computers easier to use.
Many people bought the Macintosh.
But in 1985, Jobs left Apple.
He had a disagreement with the board.
He started a new company called NeXT.
NeXT made powerful computers.
They were used in universities and businesses.
In 1996, Apple bought NeXT.
Jobs returned to Apple.
He became the CEO.
Under his leadership, Apple created many new products.
In 2001, Apple released the iPod.
It changed the way people listened to music.
In 2007, Apple released the iPhone.
It changed the way people used phones.
In 2010, Apple released the iPad.
It was a new kind of computer.
Jobs was known for his vision.
He wanted to make products that were easy to use.
He also wanted them to look good.
He paid attention to every detail.
This made Apple products very popular.
Steve Jobs passed away on October 5, 2011.
He left a big mark on the world.
His ideas and products changed technology forever.
People still use and love Apple products today.
Jobs' story is one of creativity and innovation.
He showed that with hard work and vision, you can change the world.
